name: openfinalshell
description: 开源 FinalShell —— SSH 终端 + SFTP + 服务器监控三合一的桌面客户端
author: openfinalshell contributors

scripts.dev: node -e "const { existsSync }=require('fs'),{ resolve }=require('path'),{ spawn }=require('child_process');const platform=process.platform==='win32'?'win':process.platform==='darwin'?'mac':'linux';const arch=process.arch==='arm64'?'arm64':process.arch==='ia32'?'ia32':'x64';const exe=platform==='win'?'ofs-rdp-worker.exe':'ofs-rdp-worker';const worker=resolve('build/rdp-worker',exe);const env={...process.env};if(existsSync(worker)){env.OFS_RDP_WORKER=worker;console.log('[RDP] development worker: '+worker)}else{console.warn('[RDP] development worker not found for '+platform+'/'+arch+'; embedded RDP will report WORKER_MISSING. Build a local worker when the FreeRDP toolchain is available: npm run build:rdp-worker -- --platform '+platform+' --arch '+arch+'. Release builds must use --require-freerdp.')}const child=spawn(process.execPath,[resolve('node_modules/electron-vite/bin/electron-vite.js'),'dev','--watch'],{stdio:'inherit',env});child.on('exit',(code,signal)=>process.exit(code??(signal?1:0)));"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.package: npm run build:rdp-worker -- --platform win --arch x64 --require-freerdp && npm run check:rdp-worker -- --platform win --arch x64 --require-freerdp && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never && npm run check:rdp-worker -- --platform win --arch x64 --app-dir release/win-unpacked --require-freerdp
scripts.package:deb: npm run build:rdp-worker -- --platform linux --arch x64 --package-disabled && npm run check:rdp-worker -- --platform linux --arch x64 --expect-absent && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux deb --x64 --publish never && npm run check:rdp-worker -- --platform linux --arch x64 --app-dir release/linux-unpacked --expect-absent
scripts.package:win:arm64: npm run build:rdp-worker -- --platform win --arch arm64 --package-disabled && npm run check:rdp-worker -- --platform win --arch arm64 --expect-absent && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --arm64 --publish never && npm run check:rdp-worker -- --platform win --arch arm64 --app-dir release/win-arm64-unpacked --expect-absent
scripts.package:linux: npm run build:rdp-worker -- --platform linux --arch x64 --package-disabled && npm run check:rdp-worker -- --platform linux --arch x64 --expect-absent && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux deb rpm AppImage flatpak --x64 --publish never && npm run check:rdp-worker -- --platform linux --arch x64 --app-dir release/linux-unpacked --expect-absent
scripts.package:linux:arm64: npm run build:rdp-worker -- --platform linux --arch arm64 --package-disabled && npm run check:rdp-worker -- --platform linux --arch arm64 --expect-absent && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux deb rpm AppImage --arm64 --publish never && npm run check:rdp-worker -- --platform linux --arch arm64 --app-dir release/linux-arm64-unpacked --expect-absent
scripts.package:dir: npm run build:rdp-worker -- --platform win --arch x64 --require-freerdp && npm run check:rdp-worker -- --platform win --arch x64 --require-freerdp && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir --publish never && npm run check:rdp-worker -- --platform win --arch x64 --app-dir release/win-unpacked --require-freerdp
